acceptance_impact.R7-2/R7-3: Shared mapping-node requested-layout/count admission before fallible allocation, through original actual node lifetime. Other metadata, signed-principal/general heap and allocator overhead remain.
acceptance_impact.R7-4/R7-5: Serialized real-node exhaustion, trusted reserve and real public unmap at total exhaustion. No sustained concurrent EL0 or measured essential-service latency/progress proof.
acceptance_impact.R18/G1: Existing complete prepared/published/detached mapping owner retains original admission under guarded abandonment. Broader destructor/IRQ/context/hardware-failure/custody gates remain.

admission.scope: All memory-object CPU mapping nodes, including overlapping unused preparation, publication, detached selected/whole-map retirement and abandonment. Layout includes link, payload and typed charge; counter reservation precedes allocator.
admission.classification: Exact captured caller handle checked against trusted memory sponsor before counter/factory. Reused ASID cannot select successor reserve; late promotion does not reclassify or redirect original refund.
admission.lifetime: PreparedEntry and AdmittedMap/RetiredEntry share one Charge type. Common release_node frees payload and actual node before refund; existing captured peer root completes afterward. Inert mapping preparation and retired-node/list fallback retain charges without allocator/counter/registry entry.
admission.errors: ResourceLimit for quota/allocation rejection; existing error/ABI conversions unchanged.
excluded: sustained concurrent EL0 and hardware pressure/fairness

controls.real_node_pressure: Actual fixed mapping-node layout reaches whichever byte/count dimension applies first; no synthetic saturation, quota resize/reset or pretend refund. Native observations record exact layout/count and preexisting live/retained baseline separately.

existing_guarded_retention_newly_charged.qualification: Existing deliberately retained fixtures, newly charged. No new data/root quarantine; not total kernel retention. Uncertain prefix still keeps two original data pages/root/backing charge independently.
